name: Searchkit Open-Source Search UI
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source JavaScript search UI and Node API packages for Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with no software license fee or vendor usage quota.
watch_out: NOT a free hosted search index or search API. Requires a separately operated Elasticsearch/OpenSearch cluster and app infrastructure; hosted clusters, compute, storage and traffic may cost money. The local Searchkit library itself is free for commercial use.
